triage_es (empty prompt — Spanish squad not yet configured)

_stg_environment_note: Vapi has [STG] variants for triage_en (fe47896c), triage_es-soporte (cb21f944), ivr_router (90d80c2b). Not tracked here — STG assistants are for testing and their IDs should not be pinned in prod config.

_phone_routing_note.situation: Vapi phone numbers can only be assigned to one assistant at a time. The existing +1-424-348-6010 is assigned to the English triage assistant (triage_en).

option_1_separate_number.description: Purchase a separate Spanish-language phone number for Spanish-speaking markets. Assign triage_es to that number.
option_1_separate_number.pros: Clean separation, each number can be marketed independently, no IVR friction.
option_1_separate_number.cons: Additional monthly cost (~$1-3/mo per number), requires promoting two numbers.

option_2_ivr_menu.description: RECOMMENDED. Create a new IVR/router assistant that plays a bilingual prompt, then routes to triage_en or triage_es based on caller key press. Assign this IVR assistant to +1-424-348-6010. Use Vapi assistant transfer to hand off the call.
option_2_ivr_menu.ivr_prompt: Thank you for calling Klaravex. Para español, oprima 2. For English, press 1 or stay on the line.
option_2_ivr_menu.pros: Single phone number to market, handles mixed-language callers, professional experience.
option_2_ivr_menu.cons: Adds ~3-5 seconds of IVR friction before routing. Requires building a third IVR assistant.
option_2_ivr_menu.implementation_note: Build a Vapi 'Klaravex IVR Router' assistant with a DTMF transferPlan that routes digit 1 to triage_en and digit 2 to triage_es. This is the recommended next step.

option_3_language_detection.description: Use Vapi's multilingual transcriber and a single assistant with language-aware system prompt.
option_3_language_detection.cons: Less reliable language separation, harder to tune voice per language, not recommended.

_phone_routing_note.recommendation: option_2_ivr_menu — build an IVR router assistant that transfers to triage_en (ID: 8b2cac12) or triage_es (ID: aa11f984) based on digit pressed. Market +1-424-348-6010 as a bilingual support line.
